n.name: Northern
n.bounds: Northern duck zone and Northern goose area (DWR boundaries).
n.note: Ducks Oct 3 – Jan 16. Dark and white-fronted geese Oct 3–10 and Oct 26 – Jan 31. Light geese Oct 15 – Dec 22 and Feb 1 – Mar 10.

wf.name: Wasatch Front goose area
wf.bounds: Wasatch Front goose area (DWR boundary), in the Northern duck zone.
wf.note: Ducks Oct 3 – Jan 16. Dark and white-fronted geese Oct 3–10 and Nov 10 – Feb 15. Light geese Oct 15 – Dec 22 and Feb 1 – Mar 10.

eb.name: Eastern Box Elder goose area
eb.bounds: Eastern Box Elder goose area around the Bear River refuge and Public Shooting Grounds (DWR boundary), in the Northern duck zone.
eb.note: Ducks Oct 3 – Jan 16. Dark and white-fronted geese Oct 3 – Jan 16. Light geese Oct 15 – Dec 22 and Feb 1 – Mar 10.

s.name: Southern
s.bounds: Beaver, Carbon, Emery, Garfield, Grand, Iron, Juab, Kane, Millard, Piute, San Juan, Sanpete, Sevier, Washington and Wayne counties and Tooele County south of I-80 (Southern duck zone and goose area).
s.note: Ducks Oct 10 – Jan 23. Dark and white-fronted geese Oct 10 – Jan 23. Light geese Oct 26 – Dec 15 and Jan 15 – Mar 10.

seasonsNote: Two duck zones (Northern, Southern) and four goose areas. Excludes closed areas and Native American trust lands.

seasons.label: Dark geese (Canada, cackling, brant) and white-fronted geese
Light geese (snow, blue, Ross’s)
seasons.note: After the dark goose season ends in each area, light goose hunting closes on Bear River, Fish Springs and Ouray NWRs and the Brown’s Park, Desert Lake, Farmington Bay, Harold S. Crane, Howard Slough, Locomotive Springs, Ogden Bay, Public Shooting Grounds and Salt Creek WMAs. Millard County closed to light geese Feb 15–28.

seasons.label: Tundra swans (by permit)
seasons.note: Permit by drawing; mandatory orientation course; swan area only (Northern zone).

seasons.label: Youth waterfowl hunt
seasons.note: Hunters 17 and under on July 31, 2026. Tundra swan youth hunt Sept 19 (Northern, permit).

bags.detail: Seven ducks and mergansers, inside which the limits below apply. Possession three times the daily limit.
Five dark geese (Canada, cackling, brant) plus six white-fronted geese.

rules.d: One-half hour before sunrise to sunset (DWR tables).
Nontoxic shot for waterfowl, coots and snipe. Shotguns limited to 3 shells.
From July 1, 2026 a WMA access permit is required on DWR wildlife management areas in Davis, Salt Lake, Utah and Weber counties (H.B. 30) — check DWR.
Rule R657-9-32 no-shooting areas (e.g. near the Antelope Island causeway) are not drawn; see the guidebook.
Sept 19 (Northern zone / EBE, Northern, Wasatch Front goose areas), Sept 26 (Southern).

geometryNote: Geometry: DWR’s official goose-area and duck-zone polygons, split against the Census TIGER outline and welded to Idaho and Nevada; DWR wildlife management areas (Utah land ownership layer); OpenStreetMap boat ramps; USGS NHD and GNIS; USFWS (refuge units; NWI marsh).
